speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Since there was no prenatal care and immunization records are unavailable, I need to know what specific physical findings or symptoms prompted this evaluation today. Are there any rashes, jaundice, respiratory distress, or feeding difficulties present?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of a continuous heart murmur, chorioretinitis (cloudy lenses), and hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care is highly suggestive of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. To confirm this and assess for other potential complications, I will request specific serological tests and imaging.
